chapter.verse: Mei in na taamtaak kungte a kat theih nadingin, na kongpite hong in, Lebanon aw,
Taaksan kungte aw, kapin thuum un; taamtaak kungte pukkhin a, a minthang singkungte kisia ta hi. Bashan tawsaw kungte aw, kapin thuum un; gammang tupi sing teng kiphuk ta hi.
Tuucingte, a minthan’na uh beita ahih manin, dahin kap uh hi. A tulak inn uh kisusia khin ahih manin humpinelkaite’ hawkna za un.
Topa ka Pasian in kei tungah thu hong gen a, “Gawh dinga kikoih tuuhonte va cing in.

Tuu neite in a tuute go uh a, ahi zongin daan kipia lo hi. Amaute in a tuusa zuak uh a, ‘ Topa in thupha ngah ta hen. Tu-in i hau ta hi,’ ci uh hi. A tuucingte mahmah in a tuute hehpihna nei lo uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin hih gam-a a teeng mite ka hehpih nawn kei ding hi. Amaute a ukpa leh a kumpipa’ khut nuai-ah mi khempeuh ka koih ding hi. Gam uk mite in gam sung teng susia gawp dinga amau’ suksiatna panin kuamah ka honkhia kei ding hi,” hong ci hi.

Tua summeet bawlte in kei hong cial uh a, a kigo ding tuute a cingpa ka suak hi. Kei zong ciangkhut nih ka la a, khat pen Hehpihna ci-in min ka phuak a, a khat pen Kipawlna ci-in min ka phuak hi. Tua hi a, kei zong tua tuute a cingin ka om hi.
Kha khat sungin tuucing thumte ka notkhia hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute tungah ka lungduai zo nawn kei a, amaute in kei hong mudah uh hi.
Tua ciangin kei zong tuuhonte kiangah, “Note ka hong cing nawn kei ding hi. A si ding teng si un la, a kisusia ding teng siacip un. A om lai sun teng khat leh khat kisanek un,” ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin Hehpihna a kici ciangkhut la-in ka kuaitan a, minam khempeuh tawh ka bawl thuciamna ka phiat hi.
Tua ahih manin tua ni-in thuciamna kiphiat hi. Tuu summeet bawlte in hong en giugiau uh a, hih banga ka gamtatna panin Topa ’ thugen ahih lam phawk uh hi.

Tua ciangin kei zong amaute kiangah, “Hoih na sak uh leh ka tuucin’ thaman hong pia un. Hoih na sak kei uh leh lah tang lel un,” ka ci hi. Tua ciangin ka thaman dingin ngun shekel sawmthum hong pia uh hi.

Tua ciangin Topa in kei kiangah, “Biakinn sum koihna sungah tuate koih in,” hong ci hi. Tua ciangin kei zong, kei tawh kituak-a tam a sak mahmah uh tua dangka sawmthum la-in biakinn sumkoihna sungah ka koih hi.
Tua ciangin Kipawlna a kici ciangkhut la-in ka kuaitan leuleu a, Judah leh Israel a kipawlna kiphiat hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in kei kiangah, “Khat vei tuucing nasep semkik in la, tu tungin kiman’na a nei lo tuucing nasep sem in.

Ka tuuhonte a cing dingin tuucing khat ka koih a, ahi zongin ka tuu a sia dingte huh loin, a mangthangte zong loin, a liamte bawl loin, a cidamte zong an vak lo hi. Amah in tuu thau pente’ sa ne-in, a khecinte nangawn hawkkhiatsak zawsop hi.
Kiman’na a neilo tuucingpa, a tuuhonte a nusiapa in gimna ngah ta hen! Namsau in a ban bantan hen la, a taklam mit satkham hen. A ban beimang hen la, a taklam mit tawcip hen!” hong ci hi.
